garage_workshop_sub: Every bay fits real parts for this vehicle.
garage_need_own: Buy this vehicle before you open the workshop.
garage_lab_transmission_note: Clutch, gearbox, transfer case and differential
garage_lab_tyres_note: Tyres and rims with real radius and grip
garage_dyno_note: A real pull on the rollers
garage_lab_hint_engine: Air flow, boost, fuel and heat: every part carries its own numbers.
garage_lab_hint_transmission: Get the engine's torque to the wheels with the right ratio and enough strength.
garage_lab_hint_suspension: Change travel, rate and ride height so the wheels stay on the road.
garage_lab_hint_tyres: Radius and grip; a bigger tyre will not fit the arch without a lift kit.
garage_lab_hint_body: Mass, aero and protection: all three change how the car drives.
garage_lab_hint_brakes: Brake force and how long it survives a long descent.
garage_lab_hint_brakes_extra: Clutch, gearbox, transfer case and differential are fitted in the Transmission Lab.
garage_lab_empty_slot: No part beyond stock is listed for this slot.
garage_dyno_sub: The engine you actually drive, on the rollers.
garage_dyno_no_pull: No pull has been run yet.
garage_dyno_no_compare: Press Compare with stock to see the difference.
garage_dyno_gearing_note: Both pulls use the same gear and ratio, so the difference is the parts alone.
garage_dyno_need_engine: This vehicle has no pullable engine.
garage_repair_sub: Condition of the fitted parts and what returning them to new costs.
garage_repair_explain: Every race wears the car: tyres, clutch and pads fastest. A worn part carries a lower condition multiplier and a repair returns it to New.
garage_repair_mult_note: The condition multiplier comes from the part data: 1.00 for new down to 0.00 for broken.
garage_setup_preset_note: A preset stores the fitted parts only; transfer case and differential are set separately.
garage_setup_transfer_2h: Rear axle only: lighter and cheaper on firm ground.
garage_setup_transfer_4h: Both axles at 1:1: more traction, a wider turning circle.
garage_setup_transfer_4l: Low range: multiplied wheel torque, low speed.
garage_setup_diff_open_note: Wheels turn freely: smooth in corners, but one wheel spins on a slippery climb.
garage_setup_diff_lsd_note: Internal clutches share torque across the axle.
garage_setup_diff_locked_note: Both wheels locked: maximum traction, heavier steering.
garage_setup_apply_note: Changes are written to the save immediately.
